Name: Lnh's Sequestered Farm
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][size=4][color=#ffff00]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。
Accept the commission of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/color]

[color=#00ff00]这是一个很大的农场，预先规划了布局。
在农场中可以钓到海鱼和湖鱼。
农场里放置了许多矿车，等你修复锅炉房后便可以使用。
农场的右下角有一个后花园，可以装修，种地，养动物。
和魔法农场一样，当你和法师6心时，农场和后花园会增加温室效果
默认替换标准农场，可以在配置中修改。
This is a large farm with a pre planned layout.
You can catch beach and Mountain fish on the farm.
There are many mining cars placed on the farm, which can be used after you repair the boiler room.
There is a back grden in the lower right corner of the farm that can be decorated, planted, and used for animal husbandry.
Like the Magic Farm, when you and  wizard have 6 hearts, the farm and grden will become a greenhouse.
Default replacement of standard farm, you can be modified in the config file.[/color]

[color=#00ffff]如果你喜欢它，可以点个赞吗？非常感谢
If you like it, can you endorse it? Thank you!
